cases.html:
Why We Stopped Using Synthetic Benchmarks for Parser Latency

Mina Patel · November 12, 2026 · 4 min read

Our XML reader passed every 4 KB unit fixture in under 0.3 milliseconds, yet customer exports containing 800-row spreadsheets stalled for six seconds on older laptops.

Replaying twelve anonymized production workbooks exposed an O(n²) attribute scan inside the shared-string table. Replacing two nested loops with a single linear pass cut real export time from 6.1 seconds to 94 milliseconds.

Microbenchmarks still verify edge cases, but actual export latency is now tracked against those twelve full workbooks on every pull request.
